title: Pack a sentence pair and embed it
goal:
Build BERT's input for a sentence pair (Section 3, Figure 2).

Write two functions:

- `pack_pair(a, b, cls_id, sep_id)` takes two lists of token ids and returns `(ids, segment_ids)`. The packed sequence is `[CLS] a [SEP] b [SEP]`. Segment id 0 covers `[CLS]`, all of `a`, and the first `[SEP]`. Segment id 1 covers all of `b` and the last `[SEP]`.
- `embed_inputs(ids, segment_ids, tok_table, seg_table, pos_table)` returns the sum of the token embedding, the segment embedding, and the position embedding for each position, with shape `(T, d)`. Position `i` uses row `i` of `pos_table`.
hints: `tok_table[ids]` and `seg_table[segment_ids]` use fancy indexing and give `(T, d)` arrays.
The position embedding doesn't depend on the token. Use `pos_table[:T]`, or `pos_table[np.arange(T)]`.
